sc-render-smart-button="false" itemscope=""> <section class="article-container" data-stats-ve="35"><h1>Change mode in Gemini Notebook</h1><div class="article-content-container"><div class="cc"><p>To customize your Gemini Notebook experience, you can switch between:</p>

<ul>
  <li>Dark mode</li>
  <li>Light mode</li>
  <li>Device mode</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>Important:</strong></p>

<ul>
  <li>By default, Gemini Notebook is in Device mode <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/5bSTl7VZCbueIp0cC3rIl8F2JfzS_zSkxMnvjHVKGkEZt6VLP7v7bzP3CJLX27usVV0=h36" width="auto " height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/5bSTl7VZCbueIp0cC3rIl8F2JfzS_zSkxMnvjHVKGkEZt6VLP7v7bzP3CJLX27usVV0">.</li>
  <li>In Device mode, the color scheme for Gemini Notebook matches the color scheme of the device you’re on.</li>
</ul>

<gkms-context-selector id="16263354"></gkms-context-selector><ol>
  <li>On your computer, open <a href="http://notebook.google.com" rel="noopener" target="_blank">Gemini Notebook</a>.</li>
  <li>Select Settings <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/DCTWxR8NSpeLAuJjoFNQOxeQ81rPk41gYBMaTf8KFIO3vfusid4C-TW6x8GNdXJjt-U=w36-h36" width="18" height="18" alt="Settings" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/DCTWxR8NSpeLAuJjoFNQOxeQ81rPk41gYBMaTf8KFIO3vfusid4C-TW6x8GNdXJjt-U"> <img alt="and then" height="19" src="//lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdRyBbNaOdqgeDPnH2UfxYRzt3uSLSxqij4E_7RwRG4U7TBEiDVF9YXGzvja9M5I0XxpwPtrepb25zCKtU5MZaA4g-dylkUilvLycYChEcsZvJPJOZT_xmuUHwL7HL0Xx1r46QNJw?key=kQCClX5_UIz46BYCbT7Lztn1" width="19"> Device <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/5bSTl7VZCbueIp0cC3rIl8F2JfzS_zSkxMnvjHVKGkEZt6VLP7v7bzP3CJLX27usVV0=h36" width="auto " height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/5bSTl7VZCbueIp0cC3rIl8F2JfzS_zSkxMnvjHVKGkEZt6VLP7v7bzP3CJLX27usVV0">.</li>
  <li>Switch between Light mode <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/emZmBpKdTQu9pDE-9rlLpIP93AKow3XFiGKPz1jNPfexQqTtRAxCTeoHhXZUH7MUMUVV=h36" width="auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/emZmBpKdTQu9pDE-9rlLpIP93AKow3XFiGKPz1jNPfexQqTtRAxCTeoHhXZUH7MUMUVV">, Dark mode <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/1OmKgg_IpGW47Zjoez4M6gYlr91wBD9vQhKBfpb1-CRHZr9IfElFitZoSgEpFu7uWg=h36" width="Auto" height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/1OmKgg_IpGW47Zjoez4M6gYlr91wBD9vQhKBfpb1-CRHZr9IfElFitZoSgEpFu7uWg">, or Device mode <img src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/5bSTl7VZCbueIp0cC3rIl8F2JfzS_zSkxMnvjHVKGkEZt6VLP7v7bzP3CJLX27usVV0=h36" width="auto " height="18" alt="" data-mime-type="image/png" data-alt-src="//lh3.googleusercontent.com/5bSTl7VZCbueIp0cC3rIl8F2JfzS_zSkxMnvjHVKGkEZt6VLP7v7bzP3CJLX27usVV0">.</li>
</ol>
